title: Symmetry of the second derivative of a C² map on an open set (Schwarz)
statement: For all n, N ∈ ℕ, every open V ⊆ ℝⁿ and every ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ that is C² on V: for all x ∈ V and v, w ∈ ℝⁿ, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x v w = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x w v, i.e. D²ψ(x)[v, w] = D²ψ(x)[w, v].
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ v w : Rn n, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x v w = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x w v
